[b]"...on the news, various leaders have been cited saying various things, ranging from the absurd to the idiotic; it is only natural, of course. For states not run by Technocrats to be the manifestation of all that is wrong with the world today. They pursue coin, war, and their own reputation, which I might add, will not cast a shadow, over the well-being of their people. States like the so-called United Plurinational Federal People's Republic of Rosenmarkke, so-called, referring to the People's part of the title, a flagrant lie and falsehood propagated by Strømm, who wishes to serve as a strong-woman dictator over a land she can barely preserve due to her frankly maddening policies. There are other states, of course. The United Commonwealth of Wuloosya, which promotes apartheid, a barbarous practice, likewise with the South Argoians, who likewise propagate such barbarity! Is it the tradition of the West to act as devils? Demons of unnatural realms who haunt this world with their disgusting edicts and mandates. Those who wage war, conflict and publicly proclaim the morality of it? It is not moral to wage war unjustly, nor is it moral to propagate a capitalist system! It is a disgusting thing from all perspectives of the Students of Perfection, that of course being Technocratic-Socialism. No westerner will hold a candle to the wisdom I have written! Thus, my manifesto is eternally free for all the world to have. Its brilliance can not be replicated. Despite the wide berth between Technocratic-Socialist perfection and any other form of government, there are tolerable governments, such as the Empire of Corzerran, despite their hereditary monarchy, they promote all sciences, including the magical, which Stuipendia shamefully lacks knowledge of..."[/b]
[sub][i]~ Overseer Superior LI JINPING, Extract from Li's Speech on todays Jingcast  2028[/i][/sub]

THE 31ST ARELIAN GENERAL ELECTIONS]
[i]The Amaryllis Times - Der Amaryllis Zette. Monday, February 21st 2028[/i]

The Arelian General Elections have delivered victory for the People's Platform, defeating the Democratic Union by a clear margin, and will now lead a left-wing coalition with the Greens and the Reds.

Though it was clear by late Sunday evening from the commissions offices, this morning, millions of Arelians awoke early to the news through the Arelian State Broadcasting Corporations breakfast broadcast.
Immediately, jubilation broke out in the streets, as hundreds of thousands gathered in celebration of democracy and cannons rang out in unison across the capitals.

As is custom, all cities are set to celebrate for the rest of the week, with Union Police bracing for the millions that will beset the capital ahead of the President-Elects Inauguration. 

All parties have already extended their congratulations, with the Vice President personally extending his, as the new session begins. It marks a change for the United Republic, as it follows the end of a protracted power struggle which led to the paralysation of the state, its self-imposed isolation, and the collapse of President Onerous. 
From there, Alter took charge, working to lead the country through civil unrest and managing well.

So, thank you Vice President Alter, and welcome President Manor!
We only hope for safety.

[quote=koranvistan;61384334][i]Fantastic news! The Royal Family is welcome to stay at the palace. Attached is a brief itinerary...[/i] Began Elena's cordial return e-mail. She called the head of Palace Staff, Galina, to her office to discuss Maslenitsa accommodations. The Palace would host the family from the 20th to the morning of the 24th (Sunday - Thursday), so that they could still have their holiday at home.

The first two days (Mon/Tue, Sunday is for arrival and a quiet dinner) would be spent in attendance of the Festival Dances in Velnaz and Chernigyiv- the capitol and Bolochia's "Great Stone City", a castle town and one of the frontier fortifications of the Meiora elves. Wednesday night there would be a feast at the Palace, with music played by a string quartet.

(ooc: cut to their arrival mayhaps?)[/quote]
The royal family of Corzerran arrived at Velnaz on Sunday a little after midday. They arrived at the palace in short order in a black car with golden highlights.

The first to step out was King Zachariasz, dressed in royal robes with golden scales. He went around to the other side of the vehicle and opened the door for his wife, Queen Szkarłat, taking her by the hand as she stood out of her seat; she wore a white royal robe decorated with golden patterns. The next three to exit the vehicle were Prince Joshua, the heir to the throne, Princess Kain, the minister of war, and Prince Abel, the minister of diplomacy. Soon, after the car was parked, the twin guards Mateusz and Katarzyna Strzelecka joined the royal family.

Together, the group walked towards the palace doors.
